info.title: Koda API
info.description: The koda binary: HTTP API, background loop, web app

post.summary: Creates the first admin account and signs it in. Only works while no users exist.
Logs in to the client with these settings. Does not save.
Decides how this browser plays the file and, if needed, starts converting it.

put.summary: Saves the signed-in user's position in the film this file belongs to.

delete.summary: Stops a remux/transcode session and deletes its files.

post.summary:
Adds every film-capable torrent indexer from Prowlarr, searched through
Prowlarr's own Torznab endpoints. Running it again updates them instead
of adding duplicates.
Checks an indexer's settings by asking for its capabilities. Does not save.
Starts scanning in the background; poll the GET for progress.

parameters.name: mine
parameters.description: Only my own requests. Users without request management only ever see their own.

post.summary:
Requests a film. Creates the title if it is new; if someone already asked
for it, this adds the user to that title instead of failing.

put.summary: Saves catalog settings. A new key is checked against TMDB before it is stored.
Saves the Jellyfin connection after checking it answers with the given key.
Saves the library folder after checking the server can write to it.

post.summary: Sends one release from the last search to the download client, even if it was rejected.

Searches indexers for this film now and returns every release with its verdict.
Nothing is grabbed; use `grab` to pick one, or let the background search pick.

needs_setup.description: True until the first admin account exists.

tmdb_key.description: New key. Omit to keep the current one.

CatalogSettingsView.description: Catalog settings as the UI sees them. The key itself is never returned.

ClientCaps.description: What the browser said it can decode (from `MediaSource.isTypeSupported`).

containers.description: Containers the browser plays as a plain file, e.g. ["mp4", "webm"]

max_height.description: Highest video height the device wants; larger is scaled down when transcoding.

password.description: Omit when editing to keep the stored password.

paused_until.description: Unix time until which the indexer is paused after errors.

api_key.description: Omit when editing to keep the stored key.
Omit to keep the stored key.

JellyfinView.description: Jellyfin connection as the UI sees it. The key is never returned.

movies_path.description: Folder films are imported into, as the server sees it.

LocalState.description: Where a catalog film stands locally, if it is known at all.

events.description: Any of: requested, approved, declined, grabbed, available, failed. Defaults to all.

start_seconds.description: Where to start, in seconds from the beginning of the film.

reasons.description: Why the file is not played as is.

session.description: Session to stop when done (remux/transcode only).

start_seconds.description: The stream begins at this point of the film (0 for direct play).

url.description: Plain file for direct play, an HLS playlist otherwise.

skipped.description: Indexer name and why it was left out.

cutoff.description: Stop upgrading once a file of this quality (or better) exists.

size_limits.description: Per quality key, in MB per minute of runtime.

Quota.description: Per-user request limit, stored under the `requests.quota` setting.

limit.description: Maximum films per period. Missing or zero means unlimited.

ReleaseView.description: One release from the last search, with the verdict on it.

beats_next_by.description: Why it ranks above the next acceptable release.

index.description: Position in the last search; pass it to `grab`.

searched_at.description: Unix time of the search; null if never searched since start.

title_state.description: Lifecycle state of the film itself.

path.description: Folder to scan. Defaults to the library's films folder.

unmatched.description: Names that could not be matched to a film, for the user to fix.

state.description: requested | wanted | searching | grabbed | downloading | importing | available

state_reason.description: Plain-language reason for the current state, when there is one.

password.description: Sets a new password and signs the user out of every device.

permissions.description: Bitmask: 1 admin, 2 manage requests, 4 request, 8 auto-approve, 16 manage library, 32 play.

url.description: Scheme and host only; the full address may contain a token.
